objective_text: Describe factors that can affect costs in Azure
stem: A company creates the same storage account in two different Azure regions. What should it expect about the price?
option_b: The price may differ between the regions
option_c: The second region is always free
option_d: The price depends only on the size of the company
why_correct: Geography affects Azure pricing because costs such as power and labor vary by location, so the same resource can cost different amounts in different regions.
why_a_wrong: The price is not always identical, because region is one of the factors that changes the cost.
why_c_wrong: Azure charges based on usage, and a region does not make a resource free.
why_d_wrong: Cost depends on factors like resource type, consumption and geography, and company size is not one of the listed factors.
author: yego

objective_text: Describe factors that can affect costs in Azure
stem: A team runs a batch data processing job that can safely be interrupted. Which option can lower its compute cost by using unused Azure capacity at reduced prices?
why_correct: Spot pricing uses unused Azure capacity at lower prices, which suits workloads that can be interrupted because they can be evicted when Azure needs the capacity back.
why_a_wrong: Reservations lower cost by committing to specific resources for one or three years, not by using spare capacity.
why_b_wrong: A savings plan for compute commits you to an hourly spend for one or three years, not to unused capacity.
why_c_wrong: Pay-as-you-go charges for what you use and gives no discount from spare capacity.
author: yego

stem: A team is planning a new web application and wants an estimate of its monthly Azure cost before anything is provisioned. Which tool should it use?
why_correct: The pricing calculator gives an estimated cost for resources you plan to provision. Nothing is created or charged when you add resources to it.
why_b_wrong: Cost analysis shows the costs of resources that already exist, rather than estimating planned ones.
why_c_wrong: Budget alerts notify you when spending reaches a threshold you set, rather than estimating costs in advance.
why_d_wrong: Azure Marketplace is where you buy solutions from third-party vendors, not where you estimate costs.
author: yego

objective_text: Describe cost management capabilities in Azure
stem: An administrator wants an email when spending reaches 80 percent of a monthly budget. Which Cost Management feature does this?
why_correct: Budget alerts notify you when spending reaches or exceeds a threshold you define, and an email is sent to the people on the budget's recipient list.
why_a_wrong: Cost analysis gives a visual view of your costs, while the notifications come from budget alerts.
why_b_wrong: Tags are name and value labels on resources, not a notification feature.
why_d_wrong: The pricing calculator only estimates costs and does not track real spending.
author: yego

objective_text: Describe cost management capabilities in Azure
stem: Which Cost Management feature lets you see total cost broken down by billing cycle, region or resource?
why_correct: Cost analysis gives a quick visual of Azure costs and lets you view totals in different ways, including by billing cycle, region and resource.
why_a_wrong: Budget alerts notify you when spending reaches a threshold rather than showing a breakdown of costs.
why_c_wrong: Credit alerts notify you when your Azure Prepayment is consumed, not for breaking down costs.
why_d_wrong: Spot pricing is a way to lower virtual machine costs, not a Cost Management reporting feature.
author: yego

stem: A company wants to group Azure resources by department so it can report on costs for each team. Which feature adds this kind of name and value label to a resource?
why_correct: Tags are name and value pairs that add metadata to resources, which lets you group them and report on costs by things like department or owner.
why_a_wrong: The pricing calculator estimates planned costs and does not label resources.
why_b_wrong: Budget alerts notify you about spending thresholds and do not label resources.
why_d_wrong: Azure Marketplace is for buying third-party solutions, not for labeling resources.
author: yego
